description: The editorial handover's interactions as built. Every pattern is complete as text without JavaScript (assets/js/editorial.js enhances), keyboard accessible, never scored, and sends nothing until the visitor submits an enquiry. Summaries wait in sessionStorage (30 minutes) for the visitor to edit in Let's Talk.

faq.behaviour: native disclosure; one open at a time below 768px

choice-guide.behaviour: choose one option to see its questions; Let's Talk links on the page carry ?context=<choice>; Clear selection

two-state.behaviour: Carrying / Carried: both statements remain readable without JavaScript

checklist.behaviour: Reviewed / Partly Reviewed / Not Yet Tested / Unsure per area; returns the questions for every area not Reviewed; no grade

demand-quality-check.behaviour: five single-choice questions; 'What feels most exposed?' sets Your main consideration; 'Which decision comes next?' sets Before you decide…; Discuss This With Summit carries an editable summary; Copy My Summary; without JavaScript the four considerations and the enquiry link are shown

params.topic: the page an enquiry came from (labels in the Let's Talk page's summit_topics)
params.intent: general | briefing | media | career (preselects 'What brings you here?')
params.context: a choice made on the page

contextual-lets-talk.behaviour: the topic is shown in an editable Topic field and recorded with the source route; the Future of Luxury opt-in is separate and unticked
